meaning: at least / whatever / even just

sections.label: Meaning
sections.html: 〜なりとも expresses 'at least X' or 'even just X' — a concessive minimizer acknowledging a small or minimal offer. Often in polite offers or requests: 少しなりとも ('even just a little'). Formal / literary register. Distinct from 〜なり (as soon as) and 〜なりに (in one's own way).

Formal / literary register.
Distinct from other なり constructions.

meaning: as soon as / right after (literary)

sections.label: Meaning
sections.html: V dict + なり is a literary construction meaning 'as soon as X, Y'. The main clause happens immediately following X, usually unexpectedly or dramatically. Distinct from the other senses of なり ('or' / 'any X or Y'). Formal / literary register.

sections.label: Formation
sections.html: V dict-form + なり.

sections.label: Register
sections.html: formal

sections.label: Usage
sections.html:

Distinct from other なり senses (listing 'or', indefinite 'any').

Formal / literary — rare in casual speech.

point: Noun + なりに / なりの
meaning: in one's own way / in the manner suited to

sections.label: Meaning
sections.html: 〜なりに expresses that the main-clause action is done 'in one's own way' or 'according to one's own level / capability' — often with an acknowledging nuance that someone is doing their best within their own limits. Common for modest self-assessments and acknowledgment of effort.

sections.label: Formation
sections.html: Noun + なりに (adverbial) / なりの + noun (attributive).

sections.label: Register
sections.html: neutral

sections.label: Usage
sections.html:
Acknowledges personal effort within one's own limits / style.
Common for modest self-assessment: 私なりに頑張った ('I did my best in my own way').
Also for evaluating others: 子供には子供なりの悩みがある ('children have their own kind of worries').
Neutral / slightly formal register.

meaning: in view of / considering

meaning: should be (fittingly) / ought to be

sections.label: Meaning
sections.html: 〜てしかるべき expresses that an action or state 'should be' or 'is fitting' — 'ought to be done' with a sense of fairness or propriety. Very formal / literary register, common in formal criticism and arguments about what should be done. The verb しかる is literary for 'to be fitting'.

sections.html: formal

Very rare in casual speech.
